title: Kazakh Spontaneous Speech: Spontaneity Filter, Manifest and Annotations
description: Spontaneity filter, full utterance-level manifest, experimental sets and human annotation results for a study of register-controlled evaluation and parameter-efficient adaptation of Whisper on spontaneous Kazakh-Russian conversational speech. Contains no audio and no transcript text from the underlying KSC2 corpus: only utterance identifiers, feature counts, scores and our own labels.
